parsed.scene_description: A blurry interior shot of a brightly lit supermarket aisle. Shelves on both sides are stocked with colorful canned goods, snacks, and packaged items. Decorative hot air balloon ornaments hang from the ceiling. A person walks down the aisle in the distance. Red signage is visible above the aisle.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: A person walking away from the camera down the aisle. They are wearing dark clothing and carrying a bag over their shoulder. Their face is not visible due to motion blur and distance.

objects.label: shelves
objects.observation: Multiple metal shelves lining both sides of the aisle, filled with various products like canned drinks and snack packages. Some shelves have wire baskets attached. The shelves appear to be mounted to the wall or floor but are not clearly visible.

objects.label: hot air balloon decorations
objects.observation: Several decorative hot air balloons hanging from the ceiling. They are colorful and appear to be made of fabric or paper. One green and white, one pink and white, and others partially visible. They are suspended by strings or wires.

objects.label: signage
objects.observation: Red rectangular sign with white Chinese characters mounted on the wall above the aisle. The text is partially legible and appears to be advertising a beverage brand. It is affixed to the wall or ceiling structure.

objects.label: canned beverages
objects.observation: Rows of colorful canned beverages on the left shelf. Cans feature purple, teal, and pink designs. They are arranged neatly on the shelf surface, which is supported by metal brackets.

objects.label: snack packages
objects.observation: Various snack packages on the right shelf, including red and yellow bags. Some are placed in wire baskets. The packages are stacked and appear to be in plastic wrapping or cardboard packaging.
